z-m-37-06.title: Pane ma subsets mangani 'ane 1 kana asina 6'?
z-m-37-06.topic: Nzira mbiri dzekuverenga ma subsets ane mamiriro
z-m-37-06.goal: Patsanura mamiriro nekuti ma elements akasanganisirwa here kuverenga ma subsets, uye utarise nekuenzanisa 'kuverenga zvakananga' ne 'kubvisa kubva pahuwandu hwese'.
z-m-37-06.material: Funga ma subsets X eyuniversal set U={1,2,3,4,5,6} (seti isina chinhu ne U pachayo zvakare i ma subsets). U ine ma subsets 64 pamwe chete.
z-m-37-06.thinking.0: Kushandura mamiriro kuita sarudzo yechinhu chega chega
z-m-37-06.prereq.1: Revo ye subset, uye kuti nei set ine n elements ine 2ⁿ subsets (kune element yega yega, sarudza kuti uiise here kana kwete)
z-m-37-06.s.s1.prompt: Pane ma subset X mangani umo '1 ari mu X uye 6 haasi mu X'?
z-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga kuti unofanira kusarudza 'isa/usaise' kune ma elements mangani.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.1: Shandisa multiplication principle kune ma elements asara kunze kweaya atogadziriswa.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga sekusarudza kuti uise here rimwe nerimwe remaelements mana asara mushure mekubvisa maelements maviri akasarudzwa.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvakaenzana nekuverenga kana element imwe chete yakasarudzwa. Verenga zvakare kuti ma elements mangani akasarudzwa.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakaverenga ma elements akasarudzwa akawandisa kana wakaverenga zvisirizvo zvasara. Tarisa zvakare kuti ma elements mangani anogona kusarudzwa zvisina kuramba.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.r.d: Pakuverenga nyaya nekuwanza, wakanganisa nhamba yesarudzo. Sarudzo yechinhu chega chega isarudzo mbiri, 'isa/usaise'.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.explain: Zvatogadziriswa kuti 1 yakaiswa uye 6 yakasiiwa, uye 2, 3, 4, 5 dzasara dzega dzega dzinogona kuiswa kana kusaiswa, saka 2⁴=16.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.prompt: Chinja mamiriro. Pane ma subset X mangani umo '1 ari mu X kana 6 haasi mu X'? ('Kana' inosanganisira nyaya apo zvose zvakagutsa, kwete imwe chete yemaviri.)
z-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti ma subset anoputsa mamiriro anoita sei.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.1: Patsanura kuita nyaya umo 1 ari mukati nenyaya umo asiri, uye uverenge imwe neimwe.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.r.a: Wakatakura mhinduro yedambudziko rapfuura. Nokuda kwe 'kana', X dzakawanda dzinogutsa mamiriro.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvakafanana nekuverenga chete 'nyaya umo 1 ari mukati'. Nyaya umo 1 asiri mukati asi 6 asiriwo mukati inoshaya.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.r.c: Wakaita subset yega yega segutsa mamiriro. Ko X isina 1 ine 6?
z-m-37-06.s.s2.r.d: Wakabata zvakanaka chokwadi chekuti unowana kukosha kumwe chete kunyange kana ukaona 'kana' sekubvisa nyaya dzinoputsa kubva pahuwandu hwose kana kupatsanura nyaya ndokuwedzera.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.explain: Kubvisa kubva pahuwandu hwose hwe64 nyaya dzinoputsa mamiriro, ndiko kuti X umo '1 haasi mukati uye 6 ari mukati' (2⁴=16), kunopa 48. Kuverenga zvakananga kunopa zvakafanana: X 32 umo 1 ari mukati, uye X 16 umo 1 asiri mukati uye 6 asiriwo mukati, 48 dzose.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.prompt: Unoda kuongorora kuti wakawana mhinduro ye s2 nenzira mbiri. Sarudza imwe yenzira yekuverenga zvakananga nenzira yekubvisa kubva pahuwandu hwose uitsanangure, uye uongorore mumutsara mumwe kana imwe nzira ichipa kukosha kumwe chete.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza nzira imwe uye unyore, uchipa mazita kwavari, kuti inoverenga nyaya dzipi.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa nenhamba kana imwe nzira ichipawo huwandu hwakafanana.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kubva pahuwandu hwose 64, bvisa nyaya ... idzo, dzinopa ...
z-m-37-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Munzira mbiri, marudzi e subset akaverengwa akapindirana here kana kusiiwa?
z-m-37-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakashandisa here mutsananguro yangu kuti nei masimba e2 anoonekwa (sarudzo yechinhu chega chega)?
z-m-37-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakaongorora here kuti migumisiro yenzira mbiri yakaenzana?
z-m-37-06.s.s3.model.0: Kubva pahuwandu hwose hwema subset 64, bvisa nyaya 16 dze 'hapana 1 ine 6' uye unowana 48. Kuverenga zvakananga kunopawo zvakafanana: 32 dzine 1 kuwedzera 16 dzisina 1 uye dzisina 6 zvinoita 48.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.model.1: Kana 1 ari mukati, maelements 5 asara anosununguka, saka 32, uye kana 1 asiri mukati, 6 inofanira kusiiwa, saka 4 dzasara dzinosarudzwa, zvichipa 16. Huwandu i48, uye 64−16 inewo 48.

z-m-37-12.title: 'Kana A⊂B uye B⊄C saka A⊄C' inogara yakarurama here?
z-m-37-12.topic: Kutarisa kana mhedziso yakagadzwa nehukama hwekuisanganisira (tafura yekupinda yemaseti matatu)
z-m-37-12.goal: Tonga kana chirevo chekuisanganisira chinogara chakarurama nekuvaka counterexample netafura yekupinda yema elements maviri, uye utaure kana ruzivo rwakapiwa rwunogadza hukama pakati pe A ne C.
z-m-37-12.material: Kuma subsets A, B, C eyuniversal set U={1, 2}, Seojin akati izvi: 'Kana A⊂B uye B⊄C, saka A⊄C.' Kuedza kana chirevo ichi chinogara chichishanda, uchashandisa kuti ma elements 1 ne 2 anopinda mu A, B, C imwe neimwe here (1 kana anopinda, 0 kana asingapindi).
z-m-37-12.thinking.0: Kurongedza mamiriro anofanira kugutsa counterexample kuchirevo
z-m-37-12.thinking.1: Kuvaka iwe pachako ma counterexamples netafura yekupinda
z-m-37-12.prereq.1: Zvinoreva subset A⊂B, uye zvinoreva A⊄B (A haisi subset ye B)
z-m-37-12.s.s1.prompt: Kuratidza kuti chirevo chaSeojin hachigare chichishanda, unofanira kutsvaga A, B, C dzemhando ipi?
z-m-37-12.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora chirevo chaSeojin chakapatsanurwa kuita zvikamu zviviri, 'fungidziro' ne 'mhedziso'.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza kuti chikamu chipi chinofanira kugutswa uye chipi chinofanira kuparadzwa.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.o.a: A, B, C dzine A⊂B ne B⊄C uyewo A⊂C
z-m-37-12.s.s1.r.a: Wakaratidza muenzaniso apo fungidziro yakagutswa zvizere uku mhedziso i manyepo.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.o.b: A, B, C dzine A⊂B ne B⊂C uyewo A⊄C
z-m-37-12.s.s1.r.b: Waverenga fungidziro se B⊂C. Fungidziro yaSeojin i B⊄C.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.o.c: A, B, C dzine A⊄B ne B⊄C uyewo A⊂C
z-m-37-12.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvinoparadza chikamu chekutanga chefungidziro, saka hazvina chekuita nechirevo chaSeojin.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.o.d: A, B, C dzine A⊂B ne B⊄C uyewo A⊄C
z-m-37-12.s.s1.r.d: Wakawana chiitiko apo chirevo chaSeojin chinoshanda. Kuti uparadze chirevo, unoda muenzaniso apo mhedziso i manyepo.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.explain: Counterexample inoparadza 'fungidziro inoreva mhedziso' i chiitiko apo fungidziro i chokwadi zvizere uye mhedziso i manyepo. Pano, i chiitiko che A⊂B, B⊄C, uye kwete A⊄C asi A⊂C.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira (A, B, C) 3 dzakasiyana dzinoparadza chirevo chaSeojin. Isa se 1 kana 0 kana 1 inopinda mu A, B, C (a1, b1, c1) uye kana 2 inopinda (a2, b2, c2).
z-m-37-12.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza element imwe ye B isiri muna C. Funga kana element iyoyo inofanirawo kuva muna A.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.hint.1: Ita kuti element yese ye A ive muna B nemuna C zvose.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.fail.k1: Hazvisi kuti element yese ye A iri muna B. A⊂B haishande.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.ok.k2: B⊄C inoshanda. B ine element isina muna C.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.fail.k2: Element yese ye B iri muna C, saka B⊄C haishande.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.ok.k3: A⊂C inoshanda. I muenzaniso unoparadza mhedziso yaSeojin.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.fail.k3: A⊄C inoshanda. Iyi i nyaya apo chirevo chaSeojin chinoshanda.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, A=∅, B={2}, C=∅ inopa A⊂B, B⊄C, ne A⊂C. A={1}, B={1,2}, C={1} inoshandawo. Pane matriples (A, B, C) 9 pamwe chete anogutsa mamiriro.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora counterexample imwe yawakagadzira muchimiro che A=…, B=…, C=…, uye unyore mumutsetse mumwe kuti nei A⊂C ichigona kushanda kunyangwe B⊄C.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora A, B, C dzawakagadzira semaseti uye uratidze element imwe iri muna B isiri muna C.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tarisa kana element iyoyo iri muna A.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: A={...}, B={...}, C={...}. B⊄C asi ...
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Mumuenzaniso wangu, ndakatarisa A⊂B, B⊄C, ne A⊂C zvose zvakananga here?
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakashandisa sechikonzero kuti element iri muna B chete haipo muna A here?
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ndinoziva kuti muenzaniso apo A i seti isina chinhu unogoneka here?
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.model.0: Muenzaniso: A={1}, B={1,2}, C={1}. A⊂B ne B⊄C (2 hairi muna C), asi A⊂C. Element 2 ye B isiri muna C haipo muna A, saka haina chekuita ne A.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana A=∅, B={1}, C={2}, saka ∅ i subset yeseti ipi neipi, saka A⊂C, uye B⊄C. Izvi nekuti element 1 iri muna B chete haina chekuita ne A.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.prompt: Kubva paruzivo 'A⊂B ne B⊄C' chete, ndezvipi zvaunogona kutaura nechokwadi nezvehukama pakati pe A ne C?
z-m-37-12.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa muenzaniso mumwe unopesana wawatogadzira nomumwe muenzaniso umo A⊄C.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa mumienzaniso yose miviri kana A⊂B ne B⊄C zvose zvichishanda.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.r.a: Wakangofunga mienzaniso ine A⊄C. Mumuenzaniso unopesana wawakangogadzira, A⊂C.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.r.b: Wakangofunga mienzaniso ine A⊂C. Muenzaniso wakaita se A={1}, B={1}, C={2} wacho?
z-m-37-12.s.s3.o.c: A ne C hazvina chinhu chinofanana
z-m-37-12.s.s3.r.c: Wakapamhidzira chimiro chomuenzaniso mumwe. Tarisa kana A ne C dzaiva nechinhu chinofanana mumuenzaniso unopesana.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.r.d: Wakaratidza kuti pane mienzaniso umo fungidziro imwe chete inopa mhedzisiro dzakasiyana.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.explain: Kuna A={1}, B={1,2}, C={1}, A⊂C, uye kuna A={1}, B={1}, C={2}, A⊂B, B⊄C, uye A⊄C. Mhedzisiro dzose mbiri dzinogoneka kubva paruzivo rumwe chete, saka hazvisarudzwi.

z-m-37-13.title: 'Vose vari pa 60 kana kupfuura', 'imwe pa 60 kana kupfuura', ne 'avhareji i 60 kana kupfuura' zvinobatana sei?

z-m-37-13.goal: Enzanisa maboka evadzidzi vanokwana pamitemo yakasiyana yokukwana kuti utonge hukama hwokupinda, gadzira mutemo mumwe wakawedzerwa, uye utsanangure hukama hwawo hwokupinda nemitemo yatovepo.

z-m-37-02.title: Pane mienzaniso inopikisa mingani ku 'x² inogara iri hombe kupfuura x'?
z-m-37-02.topic: Kuramba chirevo chinotanga ne 'kune real number x yose', nerenji remienzaniso inopikisa
z-m-37-02.goal: Nyora zvakarurama kuramba chirevo chakajairika ('... yose'), gadzira makosha akawanda ari mienzaniso inopikisa, uye upfupise renji remienzaniso inopikisa nemashoko.
z-m-37-02.material: Daidza chirevo chinotevera P. P: 'Kune real number x yose, x² > x.' (x² > x inoverengwa 'square ye x yakakura kupfuura x'.) Funga ma real numbers ose.
z-m-37-02.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inopikisa yakawanda
z-m-37-02.thinking.2: Kutaura kuti nei muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa wakakwana
z-m-37-02.prereq.1: Zvinoreva 'yose' ne 'imwe' (kuvapo), nema quadratic inequalities ekutanga kusvika pakubata mhinduro ye inequality x²≤x
z-m-37-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kuramba kunokodzera zvakanyanya kwe P.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kana pane nzvimbo mbiri mumutsara dzinochinja: shoko rekutanga (yose/imwe) nechiratidzo che inequality pakupedzisira.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana x² > x iri yechokwadi kune x=0 ne x=1.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.o.a: Kune real number x yose, x² ≤ x
z-m-37-02.s.s1.r.a: Wakachengeta 'yose' sezvayakaita uye wakachinja chiratidzo che inequality chete. Funga kuti 'yose' inochinja sei kana ukaramba.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.o.b: Kune real number x imwe, x² ≤ x
z-m-37-02.s.s1.r.b: Wakachinja 'yose' kuita 'imwe' uye wakabatawo kuramba kwechiratidzo che inequality zvakarurama (zvakapesana ne > ndi ≤).
z-m-37-02.s.s1.o.c: Kune real number x imwe, x² < x
z-m-37-02.s.s1.r.c: Wakachinja 'yose' zvakanaka, asi wakanyora < sezvakapesana ne >. Funga kuti nyaya x²=x inoenda kupi.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.o.d: Hapana real number x ine x² > x
z-m-37-02.s.s1.r.d: Wakaverenga kuramba kwe 'yose' se 'hapana'. Ichi chirevo chakasimba zvakanyanya kupfuura kuramba.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.explain: Kuramba kwe 'kune x yose, p(x)' ndi 'kune x imwe, ~p(x)'. Kuramba kwe x² > x ndi x² ≤ x (kusanganisira nyaya yakaenzana).
z-m-37-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma real numbers x 3 akasiyana anogutsa kuramba kwe P, ndiko kuti, mienzaniso inopikisa ku P. (Ma decimals anobvumirwa.)
z-m-37-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isa makosha mashoma e x pakati pe0 ne1 uye uone kana kuita square x kunoita kuti ive hombe kana diki kupfuura x.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.hint.2: Isa nhamba negative uye nhamba hombe kupfuura 1, imwe imwe, uye uenzanise mhedzisiro ye P.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.ok.c1: x² ndi x kana pasi. Muenzaniso unopikisa ku P.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.fail.c1: x² yakakura kupfuura x. Uku kukosha apo P inoshanda chaizvo. Enzanisa square ne x pachayo.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.explain: Ma x anogutsa x² ≤ x ndiwo nhamba dzose kubva ku0 kusvika ku1. Semuenzaniso, 0 inopa 0 ≤ 0, 1 inopa 1 ≤ 1, uye 0.5 inopa 0.25 ≤ 0.5. Pane mienzaniso inopikisa isingaperi, asi kunyange umwe unoita kuti P ive yenhema.

z-m-37-05.title: Kana 'fomu yekunyorera i mamiriro anodiwa', zvinokwana here kungoendesa fomu?
z-m-37-05.topic: Kuverenga mamiriro anodiwa nanokwana (mitemo yekutora chikamu nemanotisi ekuwedzera)

z-m-37-05.s.s1.r.a: Notisi haitauri kana chikwata chese chakaendesa fomu chinotora chikamu. Tarisa kana wakachinja nzira yechirevo.
z-m-37-05.s.s1.o.b: Kana chikwata chisina kuendesa fomu yekunyorera, chinotora chikamu mukukwikwidzana
z-m-37-05.s.s1.o.c: Kana chikwata chikatora chikamu mukukwikwidzana, chakaendesa fomu yekunyorera

z-m-37-05.s.s1.o.d: Kana chikwata chikatora chikamu mukukwikwidzana, hachina kuendesa fomu yekunyorera
z-m-37-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakaramba kunyangwe chikamu chisiri kuramba mhedziso. Funga kana chikwata chakatora chikamu chakaendesa fomu kana kuti kwete.

z-m-37-05.s.s2.prompt: Manotisi achaonekwa imwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga kwako. Kana unogona kusiya kutonga kwako kwapfuura sezvakaita, unogona kusarudza izvozvo.

z-m-37-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakavhiringidza 'havapindirani' ne 'zvakasanganisirwa'. Kana A iri mukati me B, A ne B zvinopindirana chaizvo (kana A isiri seti isina chinhu).

z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Wakashandisa zvawakasimbisa mu s1, kuti panofanira kuva nemudzidzi akaparadza (counterexample) kuti ive manyepo.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.o.b: Hapana vadzidzi vanokodzera, saka haugone kutarisa kana pane akaparadza
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Wakatora 'hapana chekutarisa' ne 'hapana mudzidzi akaparadza' sezvakafanana. Wakatosimbisa kuti hapana chiri kutarisirwa chakadaro.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Zvirisipo. Kuparadza i kuti mudzidzi ane 3 m kana kupfuura haana kumbondoendesa chikumbiro
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Waverenga chokwadi chekuti hapana vadzidzi sekuparadza. Kuparadza i chokwadi nezvemudzidzi.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.o.d: Mutemo haushandiswi kumudzidzi upi neupi, saka haisi mutemo
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.r.d: Wakatonga simba remutemo nekuti pane chiri kutarisirwa here. Mutemo unogadzirwawo kuti kana zvinotarisirwa zvamuka.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.info: Data 2: Mumathematics mutemo uyu unoverengwa se P⊂Q. P i seti yevadzidzi vane 3 m kana kupfuura, uye Q i seti yevadzidzi vakaendesa chikumbiro. Pano P i seti isina chinhu.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.after: Hapana element ye P inoshaikwa muna Q, saka P⊂Q. ∅⊂Q inoshanda kuna seti Q yese.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.o.a: I manyepo. Hapana ma elements, saka haigone kunzi subset ye Q
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti seti inofanira kuva nema elements kuti ive subset. Zvinoreva subset i 'element yese ye P iri muna Q'.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.o.b: I chokwadi. Hapana element imwe chete ye P iri kunze kwe Q
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Wakashandisa tsananguro ye subset sezvayakaita. Yakafanana ne Data 1 mukuti hapana kuparadza (counterexample).
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.o.c: I chokwadi chete kana Q i seti isina chinhu
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Waiverenga seyakaenderana nekuti Q ine ma elements here. Kana P isina ma elements, zvisinei ne Q, hapana element yakaparadza.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.o.d: I chibvumirano chakasiyana nenzira yetsananguro, pasina chikonzero
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.r.d: Haisi chibvumirano asi mhedzisiro yekushandisa tsananguro. Unogona kutaura chikonzero: hapana counterexample.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.info: Mushonga 3: Chikoro chimwechete chinewo imwe mutemo. "Hapana mudzidzi ane 3 m kana kupfuura anogona kuendesa chikumbiro."
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.ask: Tora kuti mitemo yose miviri i chokwadi. Izvi zvinopokana here?
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.after: Kana pasina vadzidzi vanokodzera, mitemo yose miviri i chokwadi. Kana pane mudzidzi mumwe chete anokodzera, mudzidzi iyoyo anoendesa chikumbiro kana kuti haaiendesi, saka mitemo miviri haigone kuva chokwadi panguva imwechete.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Izvi zvinopokana. Imwe yazvo inofanira kuva manyepo
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Waverenga 'anoendesa chikumbiro' ne 'haaendesi' sezvakapesana, saka hazvigone kuva chokwadi pamwe chete. Funga kana pane vadzidzi vanokodzera.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Hazvipokani. Hapana vadzidzi vanokodzera, saka hapana mudzidzi akaparadza mutemo upi neupi
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Wakasimbisa kuti hapana mudzidzi akaparadza mutemo upi neupi (hapana counterexample).
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Kana mudzidzi mumwe chete anokodzera achiuya, mitemo miviri haigone kuva chokwadi pamwe chete
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Wakaratidza chaizvo kuti kunzwa kwekupokana kunobva kupi, ndiko kuti, kana mudzidzi anokodzera achiuya.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.o.d: Mutemo wekutanga chete i chokwadi uye mutemo wechipiri i manyepo
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.r.d: Wakatonga kuti mutemo wechipiri i manyepo usina kutsvaga counterexample. Tsvaga kana pane counterexample.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.reflect: Kana pakutanga wakanzwa kuti 'hapana chekutarisa', kutonga kwako kwakachinja sei sezvawakafunga nezvezvinoreva counterexample? Nei zvingaita sezvisingajairiki kuti mitemo miviri i chokwadi pamwe chete?
